title: Mental Health Crisis
description: Explains normal stress reactions and the five core actions of psychological first aid, with what to say. Covers the 5-4-3-2-1 grounding technique and breathing, supporting children, panic attacks and dissociation, asking about suicide, caregiver burnout, and when to get professional help.
shortDescription: Psychological first aid, grounding techniques, and suicide risk checks
